{"filterInfo":{"filterConfig":{"id":800000,"filterDomain":"GPS_TRACK","filterName":"SmartBaseFilter","expression":"SELECT
                    id,
                    activity_type AS grp
                FROM
                    gps_track gt
                WHERE
                    1 = 1
                    -- OPTIONAL DATE_FROM and DATE_TO params. If NULL, they won't be applied as COALESCE uses start_date as fallback.
                    AND gt.start_date >= COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP(:DATE_TIME_FROM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), gt.start_date)
                    AND gt.start_date <= COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP(:DATE_TIME_TO, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), gt.start_date)
                    AND gt.start_date >= '1971-01-01'
                    AND gt.duplicate_status = 'UNIQUE'
                    AND gt.load_status = 'SUCCESS'
                    -- Planner: exclude planned routes (ideas) — they are never "done" tracks.
                    AND gt.track_source = 'IMPORTED'
                    -- OPTIONAL TRACK_IDS: comma/semicolon/whitespace-separated track IDs. Blank means all tracks in scope.
                    AND (
                        NULLIF(BTRIM(:TRACK_IDS), '') IS NULL
                        OR gt.id = ANY (
                            ARRAY(
                                SELECT token::bigint
                                FROM regexp_split_to_table(:TRACK_IDS, '[,;[:space:]]+') AS token
                                WHERE token ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    -- OPTIONAL GEO CIRCLE: if GEO_CIRCLE_1_POINT is NULL, condition is skipped
                    AND (
                        :GEO_CIRCLE_1_POINT IS NULL
                        OR EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM gps_track_data gtd
                            WHERE gtd.gps_track_id = gt.id
                              AND gtd.precision_in_meter = 1000
                              AND gtd.track_type = 'SIMPLIFIED_SHAPE'
                              AND ST_DWithin(
                                    gtd.track::geography,
                                    ST_GeographyFromText(:GEO_CIRCLE_1_POINT),
                                    CAST(:GEO_CIRCLE_1_RADIUS AS float8)
                                  )
                        )
                    )
                    -- OPTIONAL GEO RECTANGLE: if GEO_RECTANGLE_1_MIN_LAT is NULL, condition is skipped
                    AND (
                        :GEO_RECTANGLE_1_MIN_LAT IS NULL
                        OR EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM gps_track_data gtd
                            WHERE gtd.gps_track_id = gt.id
                              AND gtd.precision_in_meter = 1000
                              AND gtd.track_type = 'SIMPLIFIED_SHAPE'
                              AND ST_Intersects(
                                    gtd.track,
                                    ST_MakeEnvelope(
                                        CAST(:GEO_RECTANGLE_1_MIN_LNG AS float8),
                                        CAST(:GEO_RECTANGLE_1_MIN_LAT AS float8),
                                        CAST(:GEO_RECTANGLE_1_MAX_LNG AS float8),
                                        CAST(:GEO_RECTANGLE_1_MAX_LAT AS float8),
                                        4326
                                    )
                                  )
                        )
                    )
                    -- OPTIONAL GEO POLYGON: if GEO_POLYGON_1 is NULL, condition is skipped
                    AND (
                        :GEO_POLYGON_1 IS NULL
                        OR EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM gps_track_data gtd
                            WHERE gtd.gps_track_id = gt.id
                              AND gtd.precision_in_meter = 1000
                              AND gtd.track_type = 'SIMPLIFIED_SHAPE'
                              AND ST_Intersects(
                                    gtd.track,
                                    ST_GeomFromText(:GEO_POLYGON_1, 4326)
                                  )
                        )
                    )
                ORDER BY
                    start_date","filterCategory":"SYSTEM","filterType":"SQL","description":"Filters tracks by date range and optional geographic shapes (circle, rectangle, polygon).
